purpose: Read-only check for dropped visible character codes or incorrect graphics-bit layout
method: Render each code 128 through 191 with the emulator's actual font at size 26, offset (0,-1), into an 8x26 grayscale cell. Threshold at 127 at x=[2,6], y=[4,13,21], the six block interiors. Compare the resulting 3x2 raster exactly against rl.model.render_table()[code,:,:,0]. Separately enumerate every byte value in the archived replay frames and check encoder range coverage.
limitations: Character-range coverage is verified only for this recorded stage-1 game, not unseen stages.
The graphics-bit test covers all 64 semigraphics glyphs; ASCII remains an explicit code-value channel, not a rasterized glyph channel.
This checks encoding fidelity, not whether learned features preserve the information needed for successful control.
